{{short description|German physicist}}
{{BLP sources|date=April 2017}}

'''Wolfgang Parak''' (born 22 February 1970 in [[Dachau, Bavaria]], Germany)<ref name="ucs" /> is a German Professor at the Institute for Nanostructure and Solid State Physics of the [[University of Hamburg]].<ref name="Fachbereich Physik 2020">{{cite web | title=Prof. Dr. Wolfgang Parak : Nanostructure and Solid State Physics : Universität Hamburg | website=Fachbereich Physik | date=18 September 2020 | url=https://www.physik.uni-hamburg.de/en/inf/ag-parak/team/wolfgang-parak.html | access-date=13 January 2022}}</ref> He is head of the Biofunctional [[Nanomaterials]] Unit at CIC biomaGUNE, [[San Sebastián|San Sebastian]], Spain.<ref name="ucs">{{cite web|url=https://www.usc.es/ciqus/sites/default/files/cartel_conferencia_prof_wolfgang_parak_0.pdf|format=PDF|title=Conferencia : Interaction of colloids with cells (in vitro and in vivo) : Wolfgang Parak|website=Usc.es|access-date=22 February 2022}}</ref> He received his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in 1999 from [[LMU Munich]], Germany.<ref name="kr" /> From 2000 to 2002, he was Postdoc at the Department of Chemistry at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] under [[Paul Alivisatos]].<ref name="kr">{{cite web|url=https://sympo.nanokorea.or.kr/upload/speakers/1622002997_ETU_EC9AB8ED9484EAB095.pdf|format=PDF|title=Wolfgang Parak : CV|website=Sympo.nanokorea.or.kr|access-date=22 February 2022}}</ref>
From 2007 to 2017, he was Professor of Experimental Physics at [[Marburg University]], Germany.

{{As of|2022}}, Parak has an [[h-index]] of 111 according to [[Google Scholar]]<ref>{{Google Scholar id|AoconRsAAAAJ}}</ref> and of 100 according to [[Scopus]].<ref>{{Scopus id|6701351363}}</ref>

Parak is an Associate Editor of ''ACS Nano''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://pubs.acs.org/page/ancac3/editors.html|title=ACS Nano : Associate Editor|website=Pubs.acs.org|access-date=22 February 2022}}</ref><ref name="ACS Publications">{{cite web | title=Editorial Board | website=ACS Publications | url=https://pubs.acs.org/page/ancac3/editors.html | access-date=13 January 2022}}</ref> (2010–present), and ''Nanotoxicology'' (2009–2010). He is / was in the advisory board of the following journals: ''Angewandte Chemie'' (2014–present), ''Theragnostics'' (2014–present), ''Nanomaterials'' (2014–present), ''ChemNanoMat'' (2014–present), ''Colloids and Interface Science Communications'' (2014–present), ''Particle & Particle Systems Characterization'' (2013–present), ''Nanotoxicology'' (2010–present), ''Journal of Colloid and Interface Science'' (2009–present), ''The All Results Journal'' (2008–present), ''Journal of Nanobiotechnology'' (2011–present), ''Recent Patents on Nanotechnology'' (2007–2010), and ''Journal of Nanobiosensors in Disease Diagnosis'' (2011–2013).<ref name="ucs" />

== Awards and accolades ==
*2009 "Nanoscience" – award 2008 from the Association of Nanotechnology-Centres Germany (AGenNT)<ref name="kr" />
*2011 Ranked #59 in Top Materials Scientists of the past decade by Essential Science Indicators<ref name="kr" />
*2012 Awarded Chinese Academy of Sciences Visiting Professorship for Senior International Scientists<ref name="kr" />
*2014 Highly cited in the category materials sciences<ref name="kr" />
*2018 Bioconjugate Chemistry Lectureship Award<ref name="ACS Axial 2018">{{cite web | title=2018 Bioconjugate Chemistry Lectureship Award Goes to Professor Wolfgang J. Parak | website=ACS Axial | date=26 April 2018 | url=https://axial.acs.org/2018/04/26/bioconjugate-chemistry-lectureship/ | access-date=13 January 2022}}</ref>
*2019 SPIE Community Champion<ref name="SPIE Homepage">{{cite web | title=Wolfgang Parak | website=SPIE Homepage | url=https://spie.org/profile/Wolfgang.Parak-61350 | access-date=13 January 2022}}</ref>
*2020 Highly Cited Researcher 2020<ref name="Universität Hamburg 2020">{{cite web | title=Wolfgang Parak – Highly Cited Researcher 2020 | website=Universität Hamburg | date=21 November 2020 | url=https://www.physik.uni-hamburg.de/inf/news-inf/2020-11-highly-cited-researcher.html | language=de | access-date=13 January 2022}}</ref>
*2021 Fellow American Institute for Medical and Biological Engineering (AIMBE)<ref name="AIMBE">{{cite web | title=Wolfgang Parak Dr. Wolfgang Parak to be inducted into medical and biological engineering elite | website=AIMBE | url=https://aimbe.org/dr-wolfgang-parak-to-be-inducted-into-medical-and-biological-engineering-elite-3/ | access-date=13 January 2022}}</ref><ref name="kr" />
